ShortDescription.Value: Earn achievements even with mods enabled. Keeps achievement tracking on. Enjoy :)

Publish.LongDescription:
## Achievement Fixer Keeps achievements active even when you have mods.
### How it works * Just keep it installed - no set up needed. * Re-enables achievements after any city is loaded or switched. * Replaces the in-game warning ["Achievements are disabled because of mods"]. * No donations requested, just click Like button (top right) so more people know about the mod. * All source code shown (Github cat icon on the right). No mystery downloads or hidden code with no contact info.
### Notes * Safe to remove any time; does not touch saves. * Remove other "achievement" mods to avoid conflicts. * Game does not retroactively grant past progress. This prevents **future** misses by keeping the achievement flag `true`. * Mod does not use Harmony patch; safer and less likely to break with game updates.
### 16 languages * Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski, Português Brazilian * 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Tiếng Việt, Português Portugal, ไทย, Українська
### Support and Feedback * If the mod helps you, give it a Like :) * Report issues on Github or Discord links (right side of page).
### Advanced tab - Past things done before installing the mod, the game will not suddenly give you the achievement. - You need to re-trigger the condition in-game again from scratch (keep this mod installed, and just do same things again). Or use the mod's Advanced tab buttons (you met the condition before, you deserve it). - Reset button to start over (if you want to do all achievements again for fun).
### Credits * RiverMochi - author * inspired by Wayzeware's old Achievement Enabler (defunct) * yenyang - code review and technical support. * rcav8tr - method to find game localization keys. * StarQ - technical support. * Necko1996 - testing * and the CS2 modding community for pointers and testing.
